title: Regular principal quotient towers over an arbitrary coefficient ring
statement: Let J be a Grothendieck topology and Λ a commutative ring, with the derived category as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let r be a non-zero-divisor in Λ, R an arbitrary unbounded complex of sheaves of Λ-modules, Y an inverse sequence of complexes, and p_n: R → Y_n compatible with its transitions. Suppose each sequence R --r^(n+1)--> R --p_n--> Y_n is short exact. For any K equipped with an isomorphism g: K ≅ QR, there is one natural isomorphism from the positive principal derived reduction tower of K to n ↦ QY_n. Its component at n composed with the canonical reduction map K → K derived-tensored with Λ/(r^(n+1)) equals g followed by Qp_n. No limit assertion or K-flatness assumption on R occurs.

proof.text: The short exact sequences give canonical cone-to-quotient quasi-isomorphisms. Localizing them gives isomorphisms in the derived category. This construction works for an arbitrary unbounded input complex.
Use reductionFunctor.mapIso of the given identification K ≅ QR followed by the proved source-library reductionConeIso. These identify the positive derived reduction levels of K with the scalar cones.

The consecutive coefficient maps have components (r,1). The scalar power identity and the assumed compatibility of the quotient projections define morphisms of short exact complexes. mappingCone.map_descShortComplex and derivedCompletionDiagram_map_comp_reductionFunctor_map prove consecutive naturality. NatTrans.ofOpSequence and pointwise invertibility assemble the natural isomorphism.

Compose the source-library reduction augmentation equation with the localized cone-to-quotient map. mappingCone.inr_descShortComplex reduces the composite to the prescribed projection after the given identification K ≅ QR.

theorem regular_principal_quotient_tower
    {C : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    (r : Λ) (hr : r ∈ nonZeroDivisors Λ)
    (R : CochainComplex (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) ℤ)
    (Y : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) ℤ)
    (p : ∀ n : ℕ, R ⟶ Y.obj (op n))
    (hz : ∀ n : ℕ, (r ^ (n + 1) • 𝟙 R) ≫ p n = 0)
    (hT : ∀ n : ℕ, (ShortComplex.mk _ _ (hz n)).ShortExact)
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, p (n + 1) ≫ Y.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op = p n)
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (g : K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj R) :
    let I := Ideal.span {r}
    let G := DerivedCategory.derivedCompletionDiagram J I K
    ∃ β : addOpFunctor 1 ⋙ G ≅ Y ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q,
      ∀ n : ℕ, (DerivedCategory.derivedCompletionCone J I K).π.app (op (n + 1)) ≫
        β.hom.app (op n) = g.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (p n)
